description: Runs ClearMind Capital's public income tax estimator for 2026 or 2027: federal brackets (IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 for 2026, Rev. Proc. 2026-35 for 2027), the chosen state's brackets (all 50 states and DC; Ohio includes its statutory $332 base above $26,050; other states use their 2026 schedules in 2027 until they publish new ones), and optionally the City of Columbus 2.5% income tax. Returns each layer's tax, the combined total, the effective rate, the top federal bracket, and a bracket-by-bracket breakdown, plus the estimator page URL to cite. Input is TAXABLE income (after deductions), applied to every layer. Excludes credits, the AMT, capital-gain rates, payroll tax, and most local taxes. General education only, not advice for a specific person. No auth; nothing is stored.

include_columbus.description: Add the City of Columbus 2.5% municipal income tax (for people who live or work in Columbus).

state.description: Two-letter state code (or DC). Default OH.

tax_year.description: Tax year: 2026 (return filed in 2027) or 2027. Default 2026.

taxable_income.description: Taxable income in US dollars, e.g. 150000.

name: estimate_income_tax
title: Estimate 2026 or 2027 federal, state, and Columbus income tax
